author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Vibe Together, an upcoming multiplayer music-making game. It is a hybrid game and music software that is built around exploration and discovery. Vibe Together will be available on Steam in 2027. A demo is coming soon.

Build songs in a new way by connecting objects together! A visual music sandbox for you to create solo or with friends. No music experience needed. Share what you make with the community and turn each song into a level you can play in different experiences like a rhythm game or a bullet heaven. 

Instead of arranging clips on a timeline, players build together in a shared space of placed nodes and connections. Music is visualized: rhythm is defined by the distance between objects, and pitch is shown by color. Signals travel along the connections, triggering beats and melodies as they reach each node. Players can see how their song works and reshape it while it plays, alone or with up to seven other people.
title: Vibe Together - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look inside the Hail Mary in this latest trailer for Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, an upcoming mixed reality game that expands Andy Weir’s sci-fi universe. The new trailer showcases the ship's interior. A new adventure with Grace and Rocky awaits in Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, coming to PICO, Android XR, and Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S this fall 2026.

Step into the role of Ryland Grace in an original chapter of the Hail Mary mission, with James Ortiz reprising his role as Rocky. Experience humanity’s last hope firsthand as deep space grows increasingly uncertain around them. This mixed-reality experience blends your own physical environment with the Hail Mary itself. Diagnose problems, improvise solutions and push the limits of science and engineering to keep the mission alive.
title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars - Official Ship Reveal Trailer
